instruction: Allow notifications to be displayed on the lock screen so I can see them without unlocking my Ubuntu system.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling notifications on lock screen. Setup disables show-in-lock-screen (false), agent must enable it (true). Uses existing vm_command_line getter and exact_match metric. Verified: gsettings returns 'true\n' when enabled.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_vm_command_line executes 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.notifications show-in-lock-screen' which directly reads the exact system setting required by the instruction
Metric comparison is appropriate: exact_match performs strict string comparison which is correct for gsettings boolean output (returns 'true\n' or 'false\n')
Expected value is accurate: 'true\n' (with newline) matches exactly what gsettings returns when the setting is enabled
Coverage is complete: Instruction has single requirement (enable lock screen notifications), evaluator checks single setting (show-in-lock-screen == true)
Practical feasibility: gsettings command is accessible at any time without UI dependencies, no postconfig needed
Data flow is correct: Setup disables setting (false) → Agent must enable it (true) → Evaluator verifies it's true
